test_overview:
Evaluated the multiplayer Monopoly disconnection/reconnection test plan end-to-end with Playwright across a Game Master view plus three independent browser contexts (Alice, Bob, Charlie, and a later fresh Charlie session).

All 13 steps passed with full points:
1) Game creation for 3 players with unique join URLs; Start disabled until all joined (6/6).
2) Game start; initial state $500/GO; Alice/Bob/Charlie turns 1-3 roll 1/2/6, buy Maple Street/Oak Avenue/Cedar Lane with correct cash; state syncs to other contexts live (8/8).
3) Navigating Charlie's tab to about:blank dropped his connection; game continued for non-current player disconnect with offline status shown (5/5).
4) Turn 4 Alice paid $200 tax ($200); Turn 5 Bob paid $32 rent to offline Charlie (Bob $348, Charlie $372) (6/6).
5) With turn belonging to disconnected Charlie, game paused with explicit banner; no advancement during 3s wait; roll disabled for Alice/Bob (5/5).
6) Revisit CHARLIE_JOIN in same profile: Charlie restored at index 6 with $372 and Cedar Lane, enabled turn controls; pause cleared for others (6/6).
7) Turn 6 Charlie rolled 2, bought Birch Square; cash $192, owns 6 and 8, synced (4/4).
8) Closed Charlie's entire browser context; game continued, offline status shown (3/3).
9) Turn 7 Alice rolled 5 to GO (+$200 → $400); Turn 8 Bob rolled 5 past GO (+$200), paid $20 rent to Alice → Bob $528, Alice $420 (6/6).
10) Game paused again on Charlie's turn; Alice/Bob cannot roll (4/4).
11) Charlie reconnected from a completely fresh browser session via CHARLIE_JOIN with position 8, $192, properties 6+8, enabled turn controls; pause cleared (7/7).
12) Turn 9 Charlie rolled 4, passed GO (+$200), paid $24 rent to Bob → Charlie $368, Bob $552; turn to Alice (6/6).
13) Final state consistent across all views: Alice GO/Maple/$420, Bob idx1/Oak/$552, Charlie idx2/Cedar+Birch/$368, all connected (4/4).

All verifications were done on the live UI (player cards, board owners/tokens, turn info, roll-button enabled state, pause banner, game log) across contexts with no page reloads except those explicitly required by the test plan. Final score 70/70.

steps.description: test_setup_and_all_players_join: GM created 3-player game (Alice, Bob, Charlie); lobby showed three player cards with unique per-player join URLs; Start Game disabled ('Waiting for players…') until all three joined via their URLs; after joining, all showed Connected/online (green dots) and Start Game became enabled (non-fatal checks passed).

test_start_game_and_initial_turns: Game start led all player contexts to gameplay view; all at GO/$500; Alice's turn; turn enforcement via disabled roll button for non-current players. T1 Alice rolled 1 → Maple Street, bought → $400. T2 Bob rolled 2 → Oak Avenue, bought → $380. T3 Charlie rolled 6 → Cedar Lane, bought → $340. Non-fatal: move/cash/ownership synced to other contexts live (≤5s) with correct logs.

test_non_current_player_disconnect_does_not_pause: Charlie navigated to about:blank; within ~30s Alice and Bob saw Charlie 'Disconnected / offline', log 'Charlie disconnected', no pause banner, and Alice could roll (enabled button, still her turn).

test_turns_while_charlie_disconnected: T4 Alice rolled 4 → Income Tax, paid $200 → Alice $200. T5 Bob rolled 4 → Cedar Lane, paid $32 rent to offline Charlie → Bob $348, Charlie $372; turn passed to Charlie with paused state.

test_game_pauses_when_current_player_disconnected: Game blocked on Charlie's turn: '⏸ Game paused — waiting for Charlie to reconnect' banner in Alice/Bob views, roll disabled; after ~3s idle wait, positions/cash/last-roll/turn unchanged.

test_reconnect_via_page_refresh: Revisited CHARLIE_JOIN in the same browser profile; Charlie saw index 6 (Cedar Lane), $372 incl. rent, Cedar Lane ownership, and enabled turn controls. Non-fatal: Alice/Bob saw Charlie online and the pause banner cleared; log 'Charlie reconnected — game resumed.'

test_turn6_charlie_after_reconnect: Charlie rolled 2 → Birch Square, bought for $180 → cash $192, owns Cedar Lane (6) + Birch Square (8) (owner-space-8 'Owner: Charlie'). Non-fatal: state synced to Alice/Bob without manual refresh.

test_disconnect_from_completely_closed_browser: Closed Charlie's entire browser context; within ~1.5s Alice/Bob saw Charlie Disconnected/offline ('Charlie disconnected' log); game continued with Alice's turn actionable and no pause.

test_turns_while_charlie_fully_disconnected: T7 Alice rolled 5 → GO, +$200 → $400. T8 Bob rolled 5 → passed GO +$200, landed on Maple Street, paid $20 rent → Bob $528, Alice $420; turn passed to disconnected Charlie.

test_game_pauses_again_for_disconnected_current_player: Pause banner 'waiting for Charlie to reconnect' shown in Alice/Bob views, turn info 'Paused — Charlie is offline', roll disabled for both; game blocked on Charlie.

test_reconnect_from_fresh_browser_session: Opened a completely new browser session (context_charlie_new) at CHARLIE_JOIN; Charlie reconnected successfully with position 8 (Birch Square), cash $192, Cedar Lane + Birch Square ownership, and enabled turn controls. Non-fatal: Alice/Bob saw Charlie online and pause cleared ('game resumed' log).

test_turn9_charlie_from_new_session: Charlie rolled 4 → from 8 to 2, passed GO +$200, paid $24 rent to Bob for Oak Avenue → Charlie $368, Bob $552; turn passed to Alice; game continued normally, observed identically across all views.

test_final_state_consistency: All three views show all players connected (non-fatal OK). Alice on GO (0), owns Maple Street (1), $420. Bob on Maple Street (1), owns Oak Avenue (2), $552. Charlie on Oak Avenue (2), owns Cedar Lane (6) + Birch Square (8), $368. Board owners/tokens and game log identical across all player views.
